properties.name: product_count
properties.description: Products listed on this storefront: what the entity's page grid shows before shopper filters.

properties.name: balance
properties.description: What is left to spend.

properties.name: code
properties.description: The full code, only on the card's view link (/gift-cards/view/{token}); null after a balance check. Anyone with the code can redeem the card; keep the code and link safe. Never print it when it is null.

properties.name: code_masked
properties.description: The last four code characters after a mask, such as •••• 4F7K. Show it to identify the card.

properties.name: currency
properties.description: The card's currency (ISO 4217). A card holds its value in this currency only.

properties.name: expires_at
properties.description: When the card expires (RFC 3339 in the store's timezone with its offset); null when it never expires.

properties.name: expires_at_label
properties.description: The expiry in the shopper's language, with the time and the store's timezone, such as "Valid until Fri, Dec 31, 2027, 11:59 PM (Hong Kong Time)" or "Expired on Tue, Mar 3, 9:00 AM (Hong Kong Time)"; null when the card never expires.

properties.name: initial_value
properties.description: The value the card was issued with.

properties.name: message
properties.description: The sender's message to the recipient, only on the view link; null otherwise or when there is none.

properties.name: shop_url
properties.description: The store's home page in the shopper's language, to start spending the card.

properties.name: status
properties.description: active: can be spent; used: nothing left; expired; disabled: paused by the store; cancelled.

properties.name: status_label
properties.description: status in the shopper's language. Print it, not the status value.

properties.name: address_lines
properties.description: The pickup address laid out the way its country writes it, ending with the country name.

properties.name: hours
properties.description: When shoppers can collect, in the shopper's language; null when not set.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Send as location_id to the shopping_mode_set action.

properties.name: instructions
properties.description: The store's pickup instructions in the shopper's language; null when none.

properties.name: ready_in_label
properties.description: How soon an order is usually ready, in the shopper's language, for example "Usually ready in 2 hours".

properties.name: selected
properties.description: True for the location the shopper is shopping for pickup at.

properties.name: stocked_only
properties.description: True when, while shoppers shop for pickup here, the catalog lists only products this location stocks (sold-out ones included).

properties.name: sale_ends_at
properties.description: When the merchant's scheduled sale ends (RFC 3339 in the store's timezone with its offset); null when the sale has no end date.

properties.name: sale_starts_at
properties.description: When the merchant's scheduled sale starts (RFC 3339 in the store's timezone with its offset); null when the sale has no start date. Use on_sale for whether a sale is running now.

properties.name: variant_id
properties.description: The variant whose price this is (a variable product's "from" price); null when it is not one variant's price.

properties.name: max_variant_id
properties.description: The variant priced at max_amount.

properties.name: min_variant_id
properties.description: The variant priced at min_amount.

properties.name: availability_reason
properties.description: Why the product cannot be bought; null when it can. out_of_stock, or in pickup mode not_at_pickup_location when the pickup location does not stock it (a location that stocks it but has sold out says out_of_stock).

properties.name: availability_reason_label
properties.description: The shopper message for availability_reason, in the shopper's language: print it, not the code.

properties.name: brand
properties.description: The brand's name in the shopper's language; null when the product has no brand.

properties.name: brand_url
properties.description: The brand's page; null when the product has no brand.

properties.name: inventory_status
properties.description: in_stock, low_stock or out_of_stock: for a variable product, its best-stocked variant's, as on the product page.

properties.name: media
properties.description: The card's image: the same media as featured_image.

properties.name: sale_ends_at
properties.description: When the merchant's scheduled sale ends (RFC 3339 in the store's timezone with its offset); null when the sale has no end date.

properties.name: sale_starts_at
properties.description: When the merchant's scheduled sale starts (RFC 3339 in the store's timezone with its offset); null when the sale has no start date. Use on_sale for whether a sale is running now.

properties.name: variant_id
properties.description: The variant whose price this is (a variable product's "from" price); null when it is not one variant's price.

properties.name: max_variant_id
properties.description: The variant priced at max_amount.

properties.name: min_variant_id
properties.description: The variant priced at min_amount.

properties.name: published_at
properties.description: When the product was published (RFC 3339 in the store's timezone with its offset); null when it never was. For a "New" badge.

properties.name: quantity_available
properties.description: How many of a product without options can be bought now; null for a product with options (a single total would not match any one option; use inventory_status) or one whose stock is not tracked. For an "Only 3 left" or "12 in stock" line.

properties.name: rating
properties.description: The approved reviews' average and count; absent when the store's reviews are off or the product has none.

properties.name: sales_count
properties.description: Units sold, as the best-selling sort counts them. For a "Best seller" badge.

properties.name: vendor
properties.description: The vendor's name in the shopper's language.

properties.name: vendor_url
properties.description: The vendor's page; null when the product has no vendor.

properties.name: apply_text
properties.description: How the shopper gets the offer, for example "Applied automatically" or "Use this code at checkout".

properties.name: auto_applied
properties.description: True when no code is needed (kind automatic or payment).

properties.name: code
properties.description: The code to enter at checkout (kind code only); null otherwise.

properties.name: condition_text
properties.description: The offer's conditions joined by " · ", for example "On orders of €50.00 or more" or "When you pay with Stripe"; empty when there are none.

properties.name: ends_at
properties.description: When the offer ends (RFC 3339 in the store's timezone with its offset); null when it has no end.

properties.name: id
properties.description: The discount's or online payment discount's id: stable, for keys and element ids.

properties.name: kind
properties.description: automatic: an automatic discount; code: a discount code the store shows; payment: an online payment discount, given when the shopper pays with that payment method.

properties.name: savings_text
properties.description: What the shopper saves, for example "15% off", "€15.00 off", "Up to 20% off", "Buy 2, get 1 free".

properties.name: title
properties.description: The headline: the store's own product page label when it set one, otherwise savings_text.

properties.name: type
properties.description: What the offer gives. payment offers are percentage or fixed_amount. For choosing an icon or style only.

properties.name: pickup_availability
properties.description: This variant's stock at every pickup location offered to the shopper, the selected one included, in fulfillment priority order: for "available at other stores". Empty when the store offers no pickup to this shopper. low_stock means 5 units or fewer available at that location; a variant that doesn't track inventory is in_stock everywhere. status_label is the status in the shopper's language: print it rather than wording the status yourself.

properties.name: sale_ends_at
properties.description: When the merchant's scheduled sale ends (RFC 3339 in the store's timezone with its offset); null when the sale has no end date.

properties.name: sale_starts_at
properties.description: When the merchant's scheduled sale starts (RFC 3339 in the store's timezone with its offset); null when the sale has no start date. Use on_sale for whether a sale is running now.

properties.name: variant_id
properties.description: The variant whose price this is (a variable product's "from" price); null when it is not one variant's price.

properties.name: requires_shipping
properties.description: Effective value: the variant's own setting when set, otherwise the product's. False for items that don't need shipping (services, digital goods, tickets, gift cards).

roots.name: age_gate
roots.description: The store's age gate for this visitor: show is true when the gate applies to the visitor's country. Copy is already in the shopper's language, with the minimum age filled in. Render the gate as the global_overlay section age-gate, and render it only when ctx.age_gate.show is true: the platform adds its gate runtime only then, so a gate rendered while show is false can never be dismissed. Give its root data-tf-age-gate, role="dialog", aria-modal="true" and an aria-labelledby heading, and mark the buttons data-tf-age-gate-confirm and data-tf-age-gate-decline. The platform hides it before first paint for visitors who already confirmed, traps focus, stores the answer for remember_days days (0: the browser session) and handles declining (decline_url, or its own come-back-later screen when decline_url is empty). Keep the page content in the HTML. If the theme renders no age-gate section, the platform adds a plain one.

roots.name: auth_form
roots.description: Safe hosted-auth form replay state after a submission.

roots.name: auth_notice
roots.description: A localized sign-in or registration status message.

roots.name: back_in_stock_for_you
roots.description: Products this visitor viewed while they were sold out that can be bought again, the ones on their wishlist first, leaving out what they bought. Only for visitors who allow personalization; empty for everyone else.

roots.name: blog
roots.description: The routed blog landing page and paginated article cards.

roots.name: blog_category
roots.description: The routed blog category metadata. The blog root carries its paginated article cards.

roots.name: blog_post
roots.description: The routed blog article, author, categories, comments, and comment pagination.

roots.name: blog_recent
roots.description: A bounded route-free list of recent published article cards.

roots.name: brand
roots.description: The routed brand metadata and storefront-visible metafields.

roots.name: breadcrumbs
roots.description: The platform-resolved entity trail (items, last one current) and home, the store root named as the store is named, so a theme renders home then items in every language.

roots.name: cart
roots.description: The current cart. Header use receives counts; rich cart surfaces receive line, price, discount, limit, and shipping data. A line whose product or variant can no longer be bought here (deleted, archived, unpublished, variant removed) is removed from the cart when a rich surface reads it; item_count then counts only the lines shown, and form_notice tells the shopper once.

properties.name: max_quantity
properties.description: max_quantity_enabled only: the most items an order may have (inclusive).

properties.name: min_quantity
properties.description: min_quantity_enabled only: the fewest items an order may have (inclusive).

properties.name: quantity
properties.description: The cart's total item quantity, the figure the quantity limits compare.

properties.name: quantity_excess
properties.description: above_maximum_quantity only: how many items to remove.

properties.name: quantity_message
properties.description: Only when the quantity is outside the limits: the notice in the shopper's language, for example "Orders need at least 5 items. Add 2 more items to check out." Print it as given.

properties.name: quantity_shortfall
properties.description: below_minimum_quantity only: how many more items the cart needs.

properties.name: within_range
properties.description: Whether the order value (subtotal after discounts) and the item quantity are both within the market's limits. Checkout refuses an order outside them.

properties.name: checkout_ready
properties.description: Rich cart only. Whether checkout can take this cart as it is: it has items, no line has an issue, and the total and item quantity are within the market's checkout limits. Disable the checkout button while false and show what to change (issues, checkout_limits). Checkout applies the same rule.

properties.name: requires_options
properties.description: True when the shopper must pick a variant first: link to `url` (Choose options) instead of an add-to-cart form.

properties.name: unit_price
properties.description: The variant's price, or the product's lowest variant price when `requires_options` is true.

properties.name: variant_id
properties.description: The exact variant to add; null when the bundle names a whole product with variants.

properties.name: amount
properties.description: Signed displayed discount: subtotal minus discounted total. A tax-rate threshold can make this negative.

properties.name: formatted_adjustment
properties.description: Nonzero effect on the displayed total, including its sign: minus for savings, plus for a tax adjustment. Render directly without adding a sign.

properties.name: issues
properties.description: Rich cart only. The lines checkout cannot take as they are, in cart order; empty when none.

properties.name: label
properties.description: The reason in the shopper's language (items[].availability_reason_label).

properties.name: line_id
properties.description: The line (items[].line_id) to update or remove.

properties.name: quantity
properties.description: The quantity in the cart.

properties.name: quantity_available
properties.description: insufficient_stock only: how many can be bought now; set the line to it to fix the line. Null when stock is not the limit.

properties.name: reason
properties.description: Why checkout cannot take the line: out_of_stock, insufficient_stock or not_at_pickup_location (items[].availability_reason). Lines whose product or variant is gone are removed from the cart instead.

properties.name: deliver_at
properties.description: The scheduled send time (RFC 3339 in the store's timezone with its offset), for machines such as <time datetime>; null when no schedule was chosen.

properties.name: deliver_at_display
properties.description: deliver_at ready to show: store time with the store's timezone named, in the shopper's language, such as "Fri, Oct 30, 9:00 AM (Hong Kong Time)"; the year appears when it is not this year. Null when no schedule was chosen. Print it as given.

properties.name: phone
properties.description: E.164, for machines (tel: links). Show phone_display.

properties.name: phone_display
properties.description: The phone in its country's international format, such as +852 9123 4567; present when phone is set.

properties.name: product
properties.description: Never null: a line whose product or variant is gone is removed from the cart before themes see it.

properties.name: requires_shipping
properties.description: False for items that don't need shipping (services, digital goods, tickets, gift cards).

properties.name: unit_price
properties.description: Null when the item has no price in the cart currency; guard it before | money.

properties.name: mode
properties.description: The cart's shopping mode: the whole cart is delivered, or collected at pickup_location. A line with no stock at the pickup location reports available_for_sale false with availability_reason not_at_pickup_location; a line asking for more than the location holds reports insufficient_stock, with quantity_available giving what it holds. availability_reason_label is the shopper message for either: print it, not the reason code.

properties.name: note
properties.description: Rich cart only. The shopper's note for the store; empty when none. Set with the cart_note_update action; checkout places it on the order.

properties.name: note_max_length
properties.description: Rich cart only. The longest note allowed, in characters (Unicode code points): use it as the textarea maxlength.

properties.name: optional_fees
properties.description: Rich cart only. The enabled optional checkout fees of the cart's current market, in the store's order; empty when it has none. Select with the cart_fee_select action. Checkout prices, taxes and charges them for the delivery market.

properties.name: amount
properties.description: Fixed fees only: the amount in the cart currency, before tax, per order or per item as apply_per says.

properties.name: applies
properties.description: Whether this cart meets the fee's conditions (chosen products or collections, order subtotal range). When false, show the fee disabled with unavailable_reason, or hide it; a choice already made is kept and charged once the cart meets them.

properties.name: apply_per
properties.description: order: charged once; item: charged for each item in the order.

properties.name: customer_text
properties.description: The text the shopper saved for this fee; empty when none.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Fee description set by the store; empty when none.

properties.name: fee_type
properties.description: fixed: a set amount; percent: a share of the order subtotal, worked out at checkout.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Send as fee_id to the cart_fee_select action.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Fee name set by the store.

properties.name: percent
properties.description: Percent fees only: the percentage as a decimal string, for example "2.5".

properties.name: percent_cap
properties.description: Percent fees with a maximum only: the most the fee charges, in the cart currency.

properties.name: selected
properties.description: Whether the shopper chose this fee. Checkout starts with the chosen fees selected.

properties.name: text
properties.description: Only for a fee that asks the shopper for text (a gift message): how to ask for it. Send the text with the cart_fee_select action (selected=true and text).

properties.name: max_length
properties.description: The longest text allowed, in characters (Unicode code points): use it as the input maxlength.

properties.name: prompt
properties.description: The field's label in the shopper's language (the store's prompt, or "Message").

properties.name: required
properties.description: Whether checkout needs the text before the order can be placed when the fee is chosen.

properties.name: unavailable_reason
properties.description: Only when applies is false: why, in the shopper's language, for example "Available on orders of ₹499.00 or more" or "Available for selected products".

properties.name: pickup_location
properties.description: The location the cart is collected from in pickup mode; null for delivery.

properties.name: price_note
properties.description: Rich cart only. price_notes.tax, price_notes.shipping and price_notes.duty as one sentence, for example "Tax included. Shipping calculated at checkout." Null when all three are. Print it as given. A theme that lets the merchant choose which notes show prints price_notes instead.

properties.name: price_notes
properties.description: Rich cart only. The total's tax, shipping and duty notes from the market's setup for the shopper's country, each on its own (null when it does not apply; all null for an empty cart), so the theme shows the ones the merchant chose. Print each as given.

properties.name: duty
properties.description: The duty note: who pays import duties (on delivery, at checkout or included), for example "Import duties and taxes may be due on delivery." Null unless a delivered item ships into the shopper's country from another one, or when the merchant emptied the note.

properties.name: shipping
properties.description: The shipping note: shipping is calculated at checkout, or free when the market ships every order free, for example "Shipping calculated at checkout." Null unless something in the cart is delivered (the cart is not collected at a pickup location), or when the merchant emptied the note.

properties.name: tax
properties.description: The tax note: what the cart total says about tax (included, estimated, excluded or calculated at checkout), for example "Tax included." Null where no tax is charged on it, or when the merchant emptied the note for the shopper's market.

properties.name: shipping_estimate
properties.description: Rich cart only. What a theme needs to estimate shipping, tax, duties and cash on delivery for the cart before checkout: the countries of the shopper's market and their state and postal code fields. POST the chosen country_code, province_code and postal_code to url (the cart_estimate action) and show its answer. Null when there is nothing to estimate: an empty cart, a cart collected in store (mode pickup), or a market with no countries.

properties.name: countries
properties.description: The countries the shopper's market sells to, in the shopper's language; selected marks the shopper's current country. Only these can be estimated: another country has other prices.

properties.name: fields_by_country
properties.description: Per country code, the address fields an estimate uses, in the order the country writes them: province_code (with its options) where the country's addresses name a state, and postal_code where it has postal codes. Same shape as customer.address_form.fields_by_country. A country with neither has an empty list.

properties.name: autocomplete
properties.description: The autocomplete token for the input.

properties.name: input_mode
properties.description: The keyboard to show: text, numeric or tel.

properties.name: key
properties.description: The address field and the input name to post it under: country_code (always first), then first_name, last_name, company, address1, address2, district, city, province_code, postal_code in the country's order (each only where the country's address has it), then phone.

properties.name: label
properties.description: The field label in the shopper's language: the store's Storefront Messages text where the store customized it, else the country's own word (Postcode, PIN code, Prefecture...).

properties.name: max_length
properties.description: The longest value the platform accepts.

properties.name: options
properties.description: The only accepted values, when the field is a fixed list (province: value is the ISO 3166-2 code such as IN-HR, label its name in the shopper's language). Post the value; show the label. The country_code field carries no options: build its select from address_form.countries. Changing the country changes the other fields: render that country's list.

properties.name: pattern
properties.description: A regular expression the whole value must match, when the country has one (postal codes).

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: A placeholder for the input (the postal code field gives an example postal code).

properties.name: required
properties.description: Whether the address cannot be saved without this field, for this country.

properties.name: row
properties.description: Fields with the same row belong side by side on one line, in the order the country writes an address.

properties.name: postal_lookup
properties.description: The postal code → state lookup, as in customer.address_form: fill the state from a postal code for its countries.

properties.name: countries
properties.description: The countries whose postal codes the lookup knows, among those this storefront sells to. Today only India (IN), from the India Post PIN directory; the list is empty when the storefront does not sell to India. Look up only for these countries.

properties.name: url
properties.description: Where to look up the state for a postal code: GET it with country_code and postal_code query parameters. A known code answers 200 with province_code (the ISO 3166-2 code to select in the province_code field) and province_name (its name in the shopper's language); an unknown code answers 404. Fill the state from the answer and leave it for the shopper to change.

properties.name: url
properties.description: Where to POST an estimate (the cart_estimate action) with country_code, province_code and postal_code, the CSRF token in the X-CSRF-Token header. The answer is JSON; see the cart_estimate action.

roots.name: category
roots.description: The routed category metadata and storefront-visible metafields.

roots.name: collection
roots.description: The routed collection metadata and storefront-visible metafields.

roots.name: consent
roots.description: Visitor consent state. available_categories lists the optional cookie categories the consent banner offers, in display order; categories lists the ones the visitor has granted.

roots.name: csrf_token
roots.description: The signed form nonce for hosted storefront mutations.

roots.name: customer
roots.description: The signed-in shopper and, when requested, their account addresses, orders, Gift Cards, and routed receipt.

properties.name: autocomplete
properties.description: The autocomplete token for the input.

properties.name: input_mode
properties.description: The keyboard to show: text, numeric or tel.

properties.description: The address field and the input name to post it under: country_code (always first), then first_name, last_name, company, address1, address2, district, city, province_code, postal_code in the country's order (each only where the country's address has it), then phone.

properties.name: label
properties.description: The field label in the shopper's language: the store's Storefront Messages text where the store customized it, else the country's own word (Postcode, PIN code, Prefecture...).

properties.name: max_length
properties.description: The longest value the platform accepts.

properties.name: options

Post the value; show the label. The country_code field carries no options: build its select from address_form.countries. Changing the country changes the other fields: render that country's list.

properties.name: pattern

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: A placeholder for the input (the postal code field gives an example postal code).

properties.name: required
properties.description: Whether the address cannot be saved without this field, for this country.

properties.name: row
properties.description: Fields with the same row belong side by side on one line, in the order the country writes an address.

properties.name: countries
properties.description: The countries whose postal codes the lookup knows, among those this storefront sells to. Today only India (IN), from the India Post PIN directory; the list is empty when the storefront does not sell to India. Look up only for these countries.

properties.name: url
properties.description: Where to look up the state for a postal code: GET it with country_code and postal_code query parameters. A known code answers 200 with province_code (the ISO 3166-2 code to select in the province_code field) and province_name (its name in the shopper's language); an unknown code answers 404. Fill the state from the answer and leave it for the shopper to change.

properties.name: created_at
properties.description: When the shopper's account was created (RFC 3339 in the store's timezone with its offset).

properties.name: display_name
properties.description: The name to greet the shopper by: their first and last name; without a name, their email once it is confirmed, else their phone number in international format, else their email.

properties.name: email
properties.description: The account email, blank when the account has none. It can be added but not yet confirmed: read email_verified.

properties.name: email_verified
properties.description: True once the shopper has confirmed the email with a one-time code.

properties.name: first_name
properties.description: First name, blank until the shopper gives one.

properties.name: active
properties.description: True when the shopper has paged into the list; open the Gift Cards panel then.

properties.name: first_url
properties.description: The first page.

properties.name: balance
properties.description: Received cards: what is left to spend. Null on sent cards to keep the balance private. Recipient details do not restrict who can redeem the code.

properties.name: code
properties.description: Received cards: the full code; null when the store no longer has it (cards issued before codes were kept) and on sent cards. Never print it when it is null.

properties.name: code_masked
properties.description: Received cards: the last four code characters after a mask. Null on sent cards.

properties.name: delivery_status
properties.description: Sent cards: scheduled (waiting for the chosen delivery time), sending, sent (handed off for delivery; the store does not track whether it reached the recipient) or not_sent (it could not be sent). Null on received cards.

properties.name: delivery_status_label
properties.description: delivery_status in the shopper's language; null on received cards.

properties.name: expires_at
properties.description: Received cards: RFC 3339 in the store's timezone with its offset, null when the card never expires. Null on sent cards.

properties.name: expires_at_label
properties.description: Received cards: the expiry in the shopper's language, with the time and the store's timezone; null when it never expires and on sent cards.

properties.name: kind
properties.description: received: a card sent to the shopper's confirmed email or phone, or one they bought for themselves; sent: a card they bought for someone else.

properties.name: kind_label
properties.description: kind in the shopper's language.

properties.name: recipient_name
properties.description: Sent cards: the recipient's name as the shopper entered it; null when none was given and on received cards.

properties.name: scheduled_at
properties.description: Sent cards: the delivery time the shopper chose (RFC 3339 store time); null when it was sent right away.

properties.name: scheduled_at_display
properties.description: scheduled_at ready to show, written like sent_at_display; null when scheduled_at is.

properties.name: sent_at
properties.description: Sent cards: when the card was sent (RFC 3339 store time); null until then.

properties.name: sent_at_display
properties.description: sent_at ready to show: store time with the store's timezone named, in the shopper's language, such as "Fri, Oct 30, 9:00 AM (Hong Kong Time)"; null when sent_at is.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Received cards: as ctx.gift_card.status. Null on sent cards.

properties.name: status_label
properties.description: status in the shopper's language; null on sent cards.

properties.name: next_url
properties.description: The next (older) page; empty on the last page.

properties.name: page_size
properties.description: Cards per page, fixed by the platform.

properties.name: last_name
properties.description: Last name, blank until the shopper gives one.

properties.name: cancel_url
properties.description: Where the customer cancels this order (the order status page's Cancel order form). Null unless the store's cancellation rules let the customer cancel it now: show a Cancel order link only when it is set.

properties.name: delivery_url
properties.description: Where the customer answers a failed delivery of this order or chooses what happens to a shipment that came back (the Delivery portal). Null unless something about the order's delivery needs the customer: show a Fix delivery link only when it is set.

properties.name: due
properties.description: The rest of the total still owed; zero once the order is cancelled.

properties.name: due_at_pickup
properties.description: The amount due is collected in cash when the pickup order is collected.

properties.name: due_on_delivery
properties.description: The amount due is collected in cash on delivery.

properties.name: paid
properties.description: Everything received for the order: Store Credit, gift cards and other payments.

properties.name: refunds

properties.name: has_amount

properties.name: is_free

properties.name: return_url

roots.name: express
roots.description: Express checkout (wallet buttons such as Apple Pay and Google Pay) for the purchase on this page: on a product page the routed product's selected variant and quantity (the cart is untouched), on the cart page the cart, and in global chrome (a cart drawer) the cart on every page, refreshed with the drawer. Print ctx.express.slot where the buttons go, typically in an "Express checkout" block under Add to cart or Checkout, and nothing else for it. The slot is platform markup that the platform's own script turns into wallet buttons: themes never contain wallet code and must not restyle, move or remove its children. On a product page the script reads the selected variant and quantity from the page's cart_add form for ctx.product.id, and hides the buttons while a selection cannot use express checkout (variant_reasons, keyed by variant id) or the form carries line properties. When available is false the slot is empty; reason (a code) and reason_label (in the shopper's language) say why, for the theme editor or a short note. The buttons also stay hidden on a device without a wallet. Nothing here varies per visitor beyond market, currency, language and shopping mode, so pages stay cacheable.
